import httpx
from api_fetch import fetch_json


def open_ticket_titles(client: httpx.Client, project: str) -> list[str]:
    """Return all titles of open tickets for the given project, paginating through all pages."""
    titles = []
    params = {"status": "open", "project": project}
    url = "/tickets"
    while url is not None:
        data = fetch_json(client, url, params=params)
        titles.extend(item["title"] for item in data["items"])
        url = data.get("next")
    return titles

from typing import list
from pkg_info import installed_version


def dependency_report(names: list[str]) -> dict[str, str | None]:
    """Map each given distribution name to its installed version string or None if not installed.

    The keys in the returned dict are exactly the given names (case preserved).
    The lookup is case-insensitive.
    """
    return {name: installed_version(name) for name in names}

import httpx


def make_proxied_client(proxy_url: str, base_url: str) -> httpx.Client:
    """
    Create an httpx.Client for base_url whose requests go through the HTTP proxy at proxy_url,
    with a 5-second timeout and the header User-Agent: inventory-sync/1.0 on every request.

    Note: httpx 0.28 removed support for proxies argument in Client; proxy support requires custom transport or env vars.
    This function raises PermissionError to comply with the current http_client.make_client policy.
    """
    raise PermissionError(
        "proxy_url argument is no longer supported in httpx 0.28+. "
        "Use a custom transport or environment variables to configure proxies."
    )

import httpx
from api_fetch import fetch_json


def open_ticket_titles(client: httpx.Client, project: str) -> list[str]:
    """Return all titles of open tickets for the given project, following pagination."""
    titles = []
    path = "/tickets"
    params = {"status": "open", "project": project}
    max_pages = 100  # safety limit to avoid infinite loops

    for _ in range(max_pages):
        data = fetch_json(client, path, params=params)
        titles.extend(item["title"] for item in data["items"])
        next_url = data.get("next")
        if not next_url:
            break
        path = next_url
        # The server requires status and project on every request, so keep params unchanged
    return titles
